channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Grocery Outlet to close dozens of stores after overexpansion
item.description: Grocery Outlet, the Emeryville-based supermarket chain, is closing 36 stores as part of an optimization plan.

item.title: Monica Rodriguez, scathing critic of City Hall, gets a free ride to a third term
item.description: No one signed up this week to run against Rodriguez, whose City Council district is based in the northeast San Fernando Valley.

item.title: Daylight saving time returns, despite perennial politicking to stop the switch
item.description: Generally speaking, daylight saving time clock changes are unpopular. Research shows most Americans favor ditching the practice. But for now, Californians will all move their clocks forward an hour at 2 a.m. Sunday.

item.title: Iran's threat to burn ships is choking off Persian Gulf oil flow to world
item.description: Whoever controls the Strait of Hormuz, off the coast of Iran, controls nothing less than the sole maritime gateway for most of the Persian Gulf’s oil riches to the world.

item.title: After week of war and political upheaval, Trump remains defiant as ever
item.description: In the last week, Trump has instigated or been forced to navigate a stunning cascade of political threats, but has remained defiant, sounding more unbothered than embattled.

item.title: Intense Santa Ana winds pound Southern California
item.description: Gusty high-wind conditions are expected to continue pounding Los Angeles and Ventura counties Saturday with moderate to strong Santa Anas persisting through Sunday.

item.title: Gas prices soaring, Trump administration sets stage to OK controversial offshore oil plan
item.description: The Defense Production Act provides the president broad authorities to influence domestic industry in the interest of national defense or emergencies.

item.title: Noma chef responds to abuse allegations ahead of pricey L.A. pop-up
item.description: Both chef Rene Redzepi and representatives for Noma say that these allegations reflect the restaurant’s past and not its current state

item.title: Laurel Canyon home burns as Santa Ana winds gust through Greater L.A.
item.description: A home in Laurel Canyon caught fire Saturday morning as Santa Ana winds gusted through Greater Los Angeles. About 100 firefighters responded to the blaze.

item.title: How top Paramount executive's ties with Vegas gambler unraveled
item.description: Surreptitious dealings with a high-stakes Vegas gambler could imperil Jeff Shell's role in Paramount Skydance as it looks to merge with Warner Bros. Discovery.
